chunks.title: fastMRI — authored demonstration summary, not original article text
chunks.text: Demonstration summary of the fastMRI knee dataset paper: fastMRI shares raw MRI k-space measurements and reconstructed DICOM images to support research on accelerated MRI reconstruction. Public reference data allows researchers to compare reconstruction methods and reproduce experiments. These data concern knee examinations; this short summary is a software demonstration fixture rather than clinical guidance.

chunks.title: fastMRI — authored demonstration summary, not original article text
chunks.text: Demonstration summary of the fastMRI dataset description: the paper describes separate training, validation and test splits for reconstruction research. Access to the actual imaging dataset requires registration and acceptance of the dataset sharing agreement. This repository includes no fastMRI images or raw k-space files and grants no rights to those data.

chunks.title: fastMRI+ — authored demonstration summary, not original article text
chunks.text: Demonstration summary of the fastMRI+ paper: fastMRI+ adds expert pathology annotations to knee and brain images from fastMRI. Its annotations include bounding boxes and study-level labels, extending the original reconstruction resource with information about visible pathology. These labels support imaging research; this fixture does not establish diagnostic accuracy or provide individual treatment recommendations.

examples.query: What kinds of data does the fastMRI knee dataset provide?
examples.answer: The dataset provides MRI k-space measurements and reconstructed DICOM knee images for reconstruction research [PMC:PMC6996599].

examples.query: How does fastMRI+ extend fastMRI for imaging research?
examples.answer: fastMRI supplies reconstruction data [PMC:PMC6996599]. fastMRI+ adds expert pathology annotations, including bounding boxes and study-level labels for knee and brain images [PMC:PMC8983757].

examples.query: Does this evidence establish which treatment is best for an individual patient?
examples.answer: The retrieved demonstration summaries do not contain sufficient cited evidence to recommend an individual treatment.
examples.faithfulness_issues: Example of insufficient evidence: these summaries describe imaging research datasets, not treatment recommendations.
